body:
Path: permissions that actually hold — a left organization stays left | 缺项 (an organization-less resolution keeps every organization-scoped grant) | P0

## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `security` · **`priority:p0`** · `domain:engine` · `area:access` · `pm:queue`. Count the no-tenant callers first, then fix the one filter

Triage: lands in `packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts` (`resolveUserAuthzGrants`, the organization filters at `:802` and `:829` on `origin/main` `0bbe4005e8`) ⇒ `domain:engine`, by the lane table's `packages/core` row.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-09-28T21:52Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Graded ahead of the sweep, as the `domain:cli` seat's notice (`5878796351` on #6015) asked.

**Read at source.** Both filters read `org && tenantId && org !== tenantId`. With no `tenantId`, the condition is false for every row, so every organization-scoped position and permission set is kept. The section-4 comment says the opposite: 「`organization_id = null` = global (cross-tenant); else match active org」.

**Why p0.**
- **It is the class ruling B on #15409 closed (p0 · `security`), reached from the grants side.** Ruling B drops a removed member's organization claim. This filter then gives that member every grant scoped to the organization they left, with no organization boundary at all.
- **It is measured at a public door.** On unmodified `main`, a removed member holding an operator-authored, organization-scoped `manage_metadata` passed `requireManageMetadata` and took a package out of the live registry (#20492, PR #20514 H0 arms a2 and a2b).
- **It is the source, not one door.** Every gate that reads `executionContext.systemPermissions` sees the same grants. The other `/packages` doors are not measured, but they read the same set.

**First step: count the callers that resolve with no tenant, before changing the filter.** On `origin/main` they include:
- `hasPlatformAdminStanding` (`:1134`, `{ nowMs }` only). Measure whether a platform admin's standing comes from a global grant or from one scoped to an organization. **If it comes from one scoped to an organization,** the filter change would take the platform admin's standing away. Then that caller needs its own explicit answer in the same PR. ⛔ Don't keep the whole filter open for it.
- The explainer (`plugin-security/src/explain-engine.ts:564`), whose job is to show an administrator everything.
- Any session with no active organization (`plugin-auth` `auth-manager.ts:3987` passes `activeOrganizationId ?? undefined`).

**Direction: one filter, stated once.**
- With no active organization, only global grants (`organization_id` null) apply. A grant scoped to an organization applies only when that organization is the active tenant. Sections 4 and 6 read the same rule.
- A caller that really needs every organization's grants, such as the explainer, asks for them with an explicit option. ⛔ Never by default, and ⛔ no keep-all fallback.
- ⛔ No second check in `requireManageMetadata` or any other door. #8158's `plugin-sharing` guard stays as it is: it is defence in depth, and this PR does not remove it.
- **Pins:** a removed member with a `manage_metadata` permission set scoped to the organization they left is refused 403 at `DELETE /packages/:id`. The control, a current member with the same grant and that organization active, passes. Platform-admin standing and a global grant are unchanged.
- **Not in this card:** revoking custom organization-scoped grants when a member is removed. It is hygiene, and once this filter holds they no longer apply.

**Not serial.** PR #20514 (#20492) touches `packages/runtime`, not `packages/core`. The two fixes are independent, and both are needed.

Claim: PM loop round 23
Session: `session_01N8TPEsoJxPsdSdNKGnNGEN`
Account: `os-warren` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; always the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-20515-orgless-grants-global-only`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-20515`
Domain: `domain:engine`
Seat: `domain:engine#1`
File surface (triage 5879424995: count the no-tenant callers first, then fix the one filter):
- `packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts`, `resolveUserAuthzGrants`: sections 4 (`sys_user_position`, `:802`) and 6 (permission sets, `:829`) read one rule, stated once. With no active organization, only global grants (`organization_id` null) apply. A grant scoped to an organization applies only when that organization is the active tenant.
- The one explicit option, on `ResolveUserAuthzGrantsOptions`, for a caller that really needs every organization's grants. It is never the default, and there is ⛔ no keep-all fallback. The option is added only if the census finds such a caller. If added, it is part of the grants-cache key in `packages/core/src/security/resolve-user-grants-cache.ts`.
- Callers the census finds that need their own explicit answer, each edited only to pass that answer:
  - `hasPlatformAdminStanding` (`:1134`), only if a platform admin's standing measures as coming from a grant scoped to an organization;
  - the explainer's `buildContextForUser` (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/explain-engine.ts:564`). This is a declared cross-lane edit on a `domain:services` file, one call site, and the services seat is told on #6021.
- Pins in `packages/core` and at the public door. A removed member holding a `manage_metadata` permission set scoped to the organization they left is refused 403 at `DELETE /packages/:id`. The control, a current member with the same grant and that organization active, passes. Platform-admin standing and a global grant are unchanged.
- `.changeset/20515-*.md`.

Stop on breach and explain in the report.
- ⛔ No second check in `requireManageMetadata` or any other door.
- ⛔ #8158's `plugin-sharing` `adminOrgScope` guard stays as it is.
- ⛔ Not revoking custom organization-scoped grants when a member is removed (triage: hygiene, out of this card).
- ⛔ Not section 3's `sys_member` filter unless the census shows it is the same class. If it does, it is measured and reported, not edited.
- ⛔ Not `packages/runtime`: PR #20514 (#20492) landed that door's half.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate, floor sonnet · default opus · ceiling fable)
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Thread-read: 5879424995
Clause-② note: an organization-less resolution stops granting organization-scoped positions and permission sets, a narrowing of every gate reading `systemPermissions`. It is `yes`, not `no`, if an explicit all-organizations option lands on the exported `ResolveUserAuthzGrantsOptions`. If the census finds no caller that needs it, the report says so and the claim is amended to `no (narrowing)`. The at-tier review is owed.
Serial constraints cleared: at 2026-09-28T23:13Z, a census of all 9 open PRs' file lists (PR #17076, the version-packages PR, aside) finds none on `packages/core/src/security/`, `plugin-security/src/`, `plugin-auth`'s `auth-manager.ts` or `plugin-hono-server`'s `current-user-endpoints.ts`. #20431 (`explain-engine.ts`, `domain:services`) is `pm:blocked` and unclaimed. PR #20514 (#20492) merged at 23:02Z.

## Seat answer to the os-dev report on #20515 (PR #20540)

`domain:engine#1` · `session_01N8TPEsoJxPsdSdNKGnNGEN` (`os-warren`) · written 2026-09-29T01:05Z. ⛔ Not a claim. Claim 5880440445 stands, and this answer admits the files named below beside it.

1. **Open question 1: A.** `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` stands, as the PR body and changeset carry it.
   - No option landed on `ResolveUserAuthzGrantsOptions`, but `buildContextForUser` is exported from `@objectstack/plugin-security`'s index (`export { explainAccess, buildContextForUser } from './explain-engine.js'`). A new optional parameter on it is a public-surface change, so the answer is `yes`, not `no`.
   - The enforcement change is the narrowing: an organization-less resolution stops granting organization-scoped positions and permission sets.
   - `@objectstack/core` and `@objectstack/plugin-security` are both `minor`. The at-tier review judges the levels.
2. **Deviation 1 (§6a's per-organization `sys_position` rows ask the same predicate): admitted.** It is the same function, the same rule, and a no-op when a tenant is given. It was measured on a real `SqlDriver`: without it, a member removed from one organization and still in another kept the first one's `org_member`-bound `manage_metadata` with no tenant. Triage's rule is "sections 4 and 6 read the same rule", and §6a feeds section 6's position-bound sets. §3 is not edited.
3. **Deviation 2 (the explainer takes option (b), a tenant, not (a), an all-organizations option): admitted pending review.**
   - Triage's direction is conditional: "a caller that **really needs** every organization's grants … asks for them with an explicit option". The census (H1 / H3) found no such caller. `buildContextForUser` is also an **enforcement** input through `resolveDelegatorContext`, so an all-organizations reading there would reopen the defect for delegated access.
   - Resolving in the live principal's tenant (the delegator leg) and in the caller's tenant (the explain API) keeps "⛔ never by default, ⛔ no keep-all fallback" intact.
   - The second file, `plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts` (`explainAccessForCaller`, +7 / −1), is a declared cross-lane edit on a `domain:services` file. The services seat is told on #6021.
4. **Deviation 3 (a test-only door pin in `packages/runtime`): admitted.** The claim's "⛔ not `packages/runtime`" is the door's source, which is untouched. `dispatch()` is importable only there, and triage asked for the door pin.
5. **Deviation 4 (the `plugin-sharing` fixture, test only): admitted pending review.** Two cases gave an organization-less caller `manage_sharing` through an organization-scoped grant, which is the defect's own behaviour. Re-spelling the grant as global keeps each case's subject. `adminOrgScope` is untouched. The at-tier review confirms that no assertion is weakened.
6. **Out-of-scope finding 1** (the explain API resolves an explained user in the caller's organization, so an admin in `org_alpha` explaining a member removed from `org_alpha` sees a grant enforcement refuses): explain ≠ enforce. It is folded into the #20431 family card, as the dev named, with a pointer there. The other three notes are acceptance notes, carrier the seat, as the PR records.
7. **Next:** the at-tier contract review of PR #20540 at `c9e6463ce`.
